# Bluetick Consultants

> > Enterprise AI consulting and digital transformation services delivering production-ready generative AI systems, industry-specific solutions, and staff augmentation for SaaS and Fortune 500 companies.

Bluetick Consultants Inc. specializes in implementing AI solutions from strategy to production in 90 days, with proven deployments for clients like MUFG Intime, Onclusive, and Edel Assurance. The firm offers both technical implementation services and staff augmentation across healthcare, BFSI, retail, logistics, automotive, legal, and government sectors.

- Generative AI & LLMs
- Enterprise AI Consulting
- Digital Transformation
- Staff Augmentation

- MUFG Intime & Link Intime
- IDIA Chatbot & Talentick.ai
- AWS Cloud Infrastructure
- HIPAA & PCI-DSS Compliance
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- Agentic AI Workflows
- ERP & Inventory Management
- Payment Integration (Stripe, Razorpay)
- Omnichannel Retail Solutions
- Business Process Automation
